14.7.2 Nested Whole/Part class variants
In case of flattening the hierarchical VFB view to the ECU flat view representation, the case may appear that one conditional SwComponentPrototype is nested within another SwComponentPrototype depending on another variance condition. As the resulting ECU flat view only has a flat representation of SwComponentPrototypes, such a double condition needs to be resolved to a single condition in the resulting SwComponentPrototypes. In this case, the variation condition formula needs to be altered such that the two (or more) individual conditions are combined in a boolean AND function.
